_note: Read by b-qa-gate (check.py --kind reel). The duration window here is the recipe's hard limit; make_spec.py narrows it to the reference's length for each order. Every perceptual item becomes a look the bot must answer yes or no, then record with --finalize.

checks.desc: Reel floor: video and audio present, 1080x1920, 30 fps, loudness near -14 LUFS, frame 0 is not black.
Length of the new reel. make_spec.py narrows this to the reference length, plus or minus 15 percent.
The narration is audible: mean volume between -40 and -3 dB.
(a) The avatar is on screen in every sampled frame, sharp, and its lips follow the voice.
(b) Captions are readable, follow the spoken words, and stay clear of the face.
(c) The reel opens with a hook, then its points, then a closing call to action, in the order and rough proportion saved in format.json.
(d) Nothing in the picture or the words matches the reference reel. The topic, the voice and the avatar are the brand's own.
(e) Frame 0 is a clean cover: not black, not a half-drawn caption.
